system.notes:
Sometimes called Void Walkers, indigo-skinned humanoids with cephalopod-shaped heads sail the darkest reaches of space in their living Void Leviathan ships in search of minds to dominate and consume.

Movement: NEAR (starglide)
system.description:
Attacks: 4 tentacle +5 (1d8 + latch) or 1 mind blast or 1 mind control

Latch. Tentacles attach to hit targets, automatically hitting the next round (DC 12 STR on turn to remove 1d4 tentacles). If all four remain latched onto the same humanoid target for 1 round, the target's brain is ripped out and devoured. Telepathy (Mind Feat). Can communicate with and hear the surface thoughts of all intelligent creatures within NEAR. DC 15 INT or the Ætherphage is able to probe memories. Mind Blast (Mind Feat). Fills a NEAR-sized cube extending from Ætherphage. DC 15 INT or 3d6 damage and paralyzed 1d4 rounds. Dominate (Soul Feat). One target in NEAR DC 15 WIS or the Ætherphage controls for 1d4 rounds.
